name: Vaultwarden
summary: Password manager compatible with the Bitwarden apps.
description:
A lightweight server for the Bitwarden password manager apps and browser extensions.

The web vault only works over HTTPS: publish it through Network → Reverse proxy with a certificate. Leave sign-ups open until your accounts exist, then turn them off.

fields.name: PORT
fields.label: Port
fields.description: Port on this server for the web interface.

fields.name: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
fields.label: Allow new accounts
fields.description: Anyone who can reach the server may create an account while this is on.
